feature_queries.name: article_static
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.article_id, e.timestamp, a.product_code, a.product_type_no, a.graphical_appearance_no, a.colour_group_code, a.perceived_colour_value_id, a.perceived_colour_master_id, a.department_no, a.index_group_no, a.section_no, a.garment_group_no, length(a.detail_desc) AS detail_desc_len
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN article a USING (article_id)

feature_queries.name: calendar
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.article_id, e.timestamp,
  EXTRACT(doy FROM e.timestamp) AS doy,
  EXTRACT(week FROM e.timestamp) AS weekofyear
FROM eval_table e

feature_queries.name: article_micro_lags_5d
feature_queries.sql:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    e.article_id, e.timestamp,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '1 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp THEN tr.price END),0) AS sales_1d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '2 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp - INTERVAL '1 days' THEN tr.price END),0) AS sales_1d_prev,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '3 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp THEN tr.price END),0) AS sales_3d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '5 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp THEN tr.price END),0) AS sales_5d,
    COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '1 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp THEN 1 END),0) AS n_txn_1d,
    COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '3 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp THEN 1 END),0) AS n_txn_3d,
    COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '5 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp THEN 1 END),0) AS n_txn_5d
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions tr
    ON tr.article_id = e.article_id
   AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp
   AND tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '5 days'
  GROUP BY e.article_id, e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  article_id, timestamp,
  sales_1d, sales_1d_prev, (sales_1d - sales_1d_prev) AS sales_1d_delta,
  sales_3d, sales_5d,
  n_txn_1d, n_txn_3d, n_txn_5d,
  CASE WHEN sales_3d > 0 THEN sales_1d / sales_3d ELSE 0 END AS frac_sales_last_day_of_3d,
  CASE WHEN sales_5d > 0 THEN sales_3d / sales_5d ELSE 0 END AS frac_sales_last_3d_of_5d,
  CASE WHEN n_txn_3d > 0 THEN n_txn_1d * 1.0 / n_txn_3d ELSE 0 END AS frac_txn_last_day_of_3d
FROM agg

feature_queries.name: article_sales_lags_fill
feature_queries.sql:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    e.article_id, e.timestamp,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp THEN tr.price END),0) AS sales_7d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '14 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN tr.price END),0) AS sales_7d_prev,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '28 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp THEN tr.price END),0) AS sales_28d,
    COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp THEN 1 END),0) AS n_txn_7d,
    AVG(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp THEN tr.price END) AS avg_price_7d,
    AVG(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '28 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp THEN tr.price END) AS avg_price_28d,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '28 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp THEN tr.customer_id END) AS uniq_cust_28d
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions tr
    ON tr.article_id = e.article_id
   AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp
   AND tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '28 days'
  GROUP BY e.article_id, e.timestamp
), out AS (
  SELECT
    article_id, timestamp,
    sales_7d, sales_7d_prev,
    (sales_7d - sales_7d_prev) AS sales_7d_delta,
    CASE WHEN sales_7d_prev > 0 THEN sales_7d / sales_7d_prev ELSE 0 END AS sales_7d_ratio,
    sales_28d,
    n_txn_7d,
    COALESCE(avg_price_7d, avg_price_28d, 0) AS avg_price_recent,
    avg_price_28d,
    uniq_cust_28d
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  *,
  CASE WHEN n_txn_7d > 0 THEN sales_7d / n_txn_7d ELSE 0 END AS avg_basket_7d
FROM out

feature_queries.name: article_recency_fill
feature_queries.sql:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT
    e.article_id, e.timestamp,
    MAX(tr.t_dat) AS last_txn_ts,
    MIN(tr.t_dat) AS first_txn_ts,
    COUNT(*) AS n_txn_hist
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions tr
    ON tr.article_id = e.article_id
   AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY e.article_id, e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  article_id, timestamp,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', last_txn_ts, timestamp), 9999) AS days_since_last_txn,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', first_txn_ts, timestamp), 9999) AS days_since_first_txn,
  n_txn_hist
FROM x

feature_queries.name: article_channel_mix_plus
feature_queries.sql:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    e.article_id, e.timestamp,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '28 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp AND tr.sales_channel_id = 1 THEN tr.price END),0) AS sales_ch1_28d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '28 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp AND tr.sales_channel_id = 2 THEN tr.price END),0) AS sales_ch2_28d,
    COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '28 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp AND tr.sales_channel_id = 1 THEN 1 END),0) AS n_ch1_28d,
    COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '28 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp AND tr.sales_channel_id = 2 THEN 1 END),0) AS n_ch2_28d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '3 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp AND tr.sales_channel_id = 1 THEN tr.price END),0) AS sales_ch1_3d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '3 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp AND tr.sales_channel_id = 2 THEN tr.price END),0) AS sales_ch2_3d,
    COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '3 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp AND tr.sales_channel_id = 1 THEN 1 END),0) AS n_ch1_3d,
    COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '3 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp AND tr.sales_channel_id = 2 THEN 1 END),0) AS n_ch2_3d
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions tr
    ON tr.article_id=e.article_id
   AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp
   AND tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '28 days'
  GROUP BY e.article_id, e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  *,
  CASE WHEN (sales_ch1_3d + sales_ch2_3d) > 0 THEN sales_ch1_3d/(sales_ch1_3d + sales_ch2_3d) ELSE 0 END AS frac_sales_ch1_3d,
  CASE WHEN (sales_ch1_28d + sales_ch2_28d) > 0 THEN sales_ch1_28d/(sales_ch1_28d + sales_ch2_28d) ELSE 0 END AS frac_sales_ch1_28d
FROM agg

feature_queries.name: group_priors_and_share_micro_5d
feature_queries.sql:
WITH e AS (
  SELECT e.article_id, e.timestamp,
         CAST(e.timestamp AS DATE) AS ts_day,
         a.product_type_no, a.department_no
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN article a USING(article_id)
), daily AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tr.t_dat AS DATE) AS day,
    a.product_type_no, a.department_no,
    SUM(tr.price) AS sales
  FROM transactions tr
  JOIN article a ON a.article_id = tr.article_id
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
), priors AS (
  SELECT
    e.article_id, e.timestamp,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.day >= e.ts_day - 1  AND d.day < e.ts_day AND d.product_type_no = e.product_type_no THEN d.sales END),0)  AS ptype_sales_1d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.day >= e.ts_day - 3  AND d.day < e.ts_day AND d.product_type_no = e.product_type_no THEN d.sales END),0)  AS ptype_sales_3d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.day >= e.ts_day - 5  AND d.day < e.ts_day AND d.product_type_no = e.product_type_no THEN d.sales END),0)  AS ptype_sales_5d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.day >= e.ts_day - 7  AND d.day < e.ts_day AND d.product_type_no = e.product_type_no THEN d.sales END),0)  AS ptype_sales_7d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.day >= e.ts_day - 28 AND d.day < e.ts_day AND d.product_type_no = e.product_type_no THEN d.sales END),0) AS ptype_sales_28d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.day >= e.ts_day - 1  AND d.day < e.ts_day AND d.department_no = e.department_no THEN d.sales END),0)  AS dept_sales_1d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.day >= e.ts_day - 3  AND d.day < e.ts_day AND d.department_no = e.department_no THEN d.sales END),0)  AS dept_sales_3d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.day >= e.ts_day - 5  AND d.day < e.ts_day AND d.department_no = e.department_no THEN d.sales END),0)  AS dept_sales_5d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.day >= e.ts_day - 7  AND d.day < e.ts_day AND d.department_no = e.department_no THEN d.sales END),0)  AS dept_sales_7d
  FROM e
  LEFT JOIN daily d
    ON d.day < e.ts_day
   AND d.day >= e.ts_day - 28
   AND (d.product_type_no = e.product_type_no OR d.department_no = e.department_no)
  GROUP BY e.article_id, e.timestamp
), art AS (
  SELECT
    e.article_id, e.timestamp,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '1 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp THEN tr.price END),0) AS art_sales_1d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '3 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp THEN tr.price END),0) AS art_sales_3d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '5 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp THEN tr.price END),0) AS art_sales_5d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp THEN tr.price END),0) AS art_sales_7d
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions tr
    ON tr.article_id = e.article_id
   AND tr.t_dat < e.timestamp
   AND tr.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days'
  GROUP BY e.article_id, e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  p.article_id, p.timestamp,
  p.ptype_sales_1d, p.ptype_sales_3d, p.ptype_sales_5d, p.ptype_sales_7d, p.ptype_sales_28d,
  p.dept_sales_1d, p.dept_sales_3d, p.dept_sales_5d, p.dept_sales_7d,
  a.art_sales_1d, a.art_sales_3d, a.art_sales_5d, a.art_sales_7d,
  CASE WHEN p.ptype_sales_1d > 0 THEN a.art_sales_1d / p.ptype_sales_1d ELSE 0 END AS share_ptype_1d,
  CASE WHEN p.ptype_sales_3d > 0 THEN a.art_sales_3d / p.ptype_sales_3d ELSE 0 END AS share_ptype_3d,
  CASE WHEN p.ptype_sales_5d > 0 THEN a.art_sales_5d / p.ptype_sales_5d ELSE 0 END AS share_ptype_5d,
  CASE WHEN p.ptype_sales_7d > 0 THEN a.art_sales_7d / p.ptype_sales_7d ELSE 0 END AS share_ptype_7d,
  CASE WHEN p.dept_sales_1d > 0 THEN a.art_sales_1d / p.dept_sales_1d ELSE 0 END AS share_dept_1d,
  CASE WHEN p.dept_sales_3d > 0 THEN a.art_sales_3d / p.dept_sales_3d ELSE 0 END AS share_dept_3d,
  CASE WHEN p.dept_sales_5d > 0 THEN a.art_sales_5d / p.dept_sales_5d ELSE 0 END AS share_dept_5d,
  CASE WHEN p.dept_sales_7d > 0 THEN a.art_sales_7d / p.dept_sales_7d ELSE 0 END AS share_dept_7d
FROM priors p
JOIN art a USING(article_id, timestamp)
